# Step 2.128: your name, your password, your email

## Layer 1, the name (builders 1 and 2: 61af9e0d, dcd2fec7, 550cc033, bd3bf88d)

- `identify` refuses an account with no own profile as `name-needed`; pages send it to
  `/account?next=` (S-125). Commands `give-own-name.ts`, `change-own-name.ts`; browser tests
  answer through the kit's `answerNameScreen`. No name (T-447): `local-unnamed-token`.

## Layer 2, the password (builder 3; T-451, T-452, S-127)

- The interface (`packages/providers/src/sign-in/sign-in-service.ts`) offered no password
  change: only `setPassword` (needs a code's proof), `confirmPassword` (checks, changes
  nothing), `signOutEverywhere`. It gains (T-451) `changePassword`: old one counted as
  `confirmPassword`'s guesses (T-225), new one by `setPassword`'s rule, other sessions
  ended, this one kept; in the stand-in and in Supabase (sign-in check, `PUT /user`, `others`).
- Done (0584915a, d52a7897): command `server/sign-in/change-own-password.ts` (T-452; mails
  once via `mail.passwordChanged`), action `password-actions.ts` (refresh), form
  `features/sign-in/change-password-form.tsx`; P6 corrected; S-127 (Google-only accounts).
- Passed: sign-in units (297), test:web, change-password-test (fails with the stand-in
  keeping other sessions), demo-hidden-numbers, kept-emails, people-on-database (mended:
  a seed person signed in twice is asked the name once), simulated-league, staff-numbers,
  test-copy-says, test-copy, harmful-text (password boxes are posted kinds: no pin).
- Mended (770f999e): admins-invitations-test. Adele and Sky were listed all along; only the
  owner's answer "Made-up Signer" broke it. Each person now answers with their own name. On
  the database nobody can be listed unnamed (seed has names; invitees named before accepting),
  so A-14's "No name yet" is proved in your-name-test: the owner sees the unnamed admin, then the name.
- Distrust: Supabase's change is unverified live (a "secure password change" setting
  would ask a nonce); `fence-filter-check` not run (no query file changed).

## Layer 3, the email (not started)

- Needs: a pending change of email (migration 0031, `npm run db:types`), a 6-digit code to
  the new address through the sign-in interface (an adapter call in both), a notice to the
  old one, the email changed only by T-73's confirmed change (T-256: owner-run function).

## Layer 3, the email (builder 5; T-455, T-457, T-458, S-129)

- T-455: the pending change is the sign-in service's (stand-in: memory beside its codes;
  Supabase: its own pending address, our store keeps the code's attempts), no table of ours.
- Migration 0031 only widens the store's codes and adds the owner-run functions (T-458).
